title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant Finance Assistant Bookkeeper

Crewe 26,500- 28,500 per Annum Pro Rata, DOE School Hours or Full-Time Full-Time Hours: 8:30am-5:30pm

Introduction

Acorn by Synergie is recruiting on behalf of a well-established and growing business in Crewe, seeking a dependable and organised Accounts Assistant to support the day-to-day running of its finance function.

This is a varied, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across different areas of accounts and is confident using Sage.

With flexible working options available, including school hours or full-time hours, this opportunity could suit an experienced accounts professional looking for a role that offers flexibility alongside a variety of responsibilities.

What We Offer
- Salary of 26,500- 28,500 per annum, pro rata, depending on experience.
- Flexible working hours, with school hours considered.
- Full-time hours also available, working 8:30am-5:30pm.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Stable, long-term opportunity with a growing business.

Key Duties
- Process purchase and sales ledger invoices.
- Match, batch and code invoices.
- Complete bank reconciliations.
- Manage credit control and chase outstanding payments.
- Process supplier payments.
- Assist with month-end procedures.
- Maintain accurate financial records.
- Handle account queries from suppliers and customers.
- Support the wider finance team with administrative duties as required.

Requirements
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Bookkeeper role.
- Good working knowledge of Sage.
- Confidence using Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines.
- Professional and personable communication skills.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Bookkeeper looking for your next opportunity in Crewe, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or get in touch with Acorn by Synergie for a confidential discussion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced accounts professional seeking flexible working without compromising on the variety and responsibility of their role.

Acorn by Synergie acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT (12 MONTH CONTRACT)
MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO 26,500 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS
POSSIBLE OPPORTUNITY TO GO PERMANENT

THE OPPORTUNITY:
We're partnering with a well-established and growing business in Macclesfield that is looking to recruit an experienced Accounts Assistant to join its finance team on a 12-month fixed term contract.
The successful Accounts Assistant will be responsible for processing customer invoices, managing financial information and resolving invoicing queries, whilst working closely with the Credit Control team to ensure accurate billing and maximise cash collection.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration, invoicing or finance experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with a company that boasts and impressive portfolio of clients.

THE ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT ROLE:
- Processing and uploading customer invoices on a daily basis, ensuring accuracy and timely completion
- Preparing and maintaining financial information, invoice documentation and detailed cost breakdowns
- Managing invoicing processes for a portfolio of national account customers, ensuring compliance with individual client requirements
- Liaising with internal departments and external partners to investigate and resolve invoicing queries
- Communicating with customers via telephone and email to resolve outstanding queries and ensure accurate billing
- Working closely with the Credit Control team to ensure invoices are processed promptly and support effective cash collection
- Investigating invoice discrepancies, identifying errors and ensuring appropriate corrections are completed
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring customer invoicing information is kept up to date
- Supporting improvements to invoicing processes and attending internal and client meetings where required
- Working towards departmental KPIs and ensuring invoicing deadlines and service standards are consistently achieved
- Supporting the wider finance and administration teams with ad hoc duties as required

THE PERSON:
- Experience within an Invoicing Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Billing Administrator, Office Administrator or Finance Administrator role would be advantageous
- Previous experience working within a fast-paced office environment is essential
- Experience within a finance team or busy customer service/call centre environment would be beneficial
- Strong Microsoft Excel and Word skills, with confidence working with financial information and data
- Experience using computerised accounting software would be beneficial
- Excellent attention to detail with strong numerical and analytical skills
- Confident communicating with customers and internal departments via telephone and email
- Excellent customer service skills and a proactive approach to resolving queries
- Comfortable learning new systems and working with digital processes
- Available to commit to a 12-month fixed term contract

title: Credit Controller
description:
CREDIT CONTROLLER
MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO 29,200 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS

THE OPPORTUNITY:
We're partnering with a well-established and growing business in Macclesfield that is looking to recruit an experienced Credit Controller to join its successful finance team.
The successful Credit Controller will take ownership of an extensive customer ledger, focusing on maximising cash collection, reducing outstanding debt and managing customer relationships.
You'll be joining an established team within a fast-paced business that boasts an impressive portfolio of clients, where you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on cash flow and financial performance.

THE CREDIT CONTROLLER ROLE:
- Managing an extensive customer ledger, ensuring outstanding debts are collected efficiently and within agreed payment terms
- Proactively contacting customers by telephone and email to chase overdue payments and reduce aged debt
- Building strong relationships with customers to encourage prompt payment and resolve outstanding queries
- Handling challenging conversations with customers professionally and confidently to secure payment commitments
- Monitoring customer accounts, identifying overdue balances and escalating potential financial risks
- Investigating and resolving payment discrepancies, outstanding invoices and customer account queries
- Working towards strict cash collection targets, SLAs and KPIs to support the achievement of financial objectives
- Maintaining accurate records of customer communications, payment arrangements and collection activity
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve disputes and ensure outstanding balances are collected
- Supporting the wider credit control team with debt reduction initiatives and improvements to collection processes

THE PERSON:
- Previous experience within a Credit Controller, Collections Advisor or Debt Recovery role within an office-based or call centre/contact centre environment
- Proven experience managing customer ledgers and proactively chasing outstanding payments
- Confident making high volumes of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations with customers
- Strong understanding of credit control processes, cash collection and debt reduction
- Previous experience with computerised accounting software is beneficial
- Results-driven with experience working towards KPIs, targets and strict deadlines
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills with the ability to build rapport quickly
- Strong IT skills, numeracy and attention to detail
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under pressure
- Resilient, proactive and confident when dealing with challenging customer situations

TO APPLY:

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Accounts Assistant - Wilmslow - Permanent - up to 30,000 D.O.E

We are currently recruiting for our well-established client, based near Wilmslow, for an Accounts Assistant to work alongside the Sales Ledger team. This role will be supporting the operation of the Sales ledger function ensuring it is accurate and efficient.

Duties:
- Allocating customer receipts accurately and efficiently
- Completing monthly bank reconciliations
- Investigating and resolving unreconciled items and discrepancies
- Banking miscellaneous receipts
- Preparing and processing general ledger journals
- Responding to queries from internal departments and external contacts
- Operating the finance system and maintaining accurate records
- Experienced using Excel

The successful candidate will have experience within an Accounts Assistant role with a strong communication skills and keen to work within an established team.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
FINANCE ASSISTANT
MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO 29,000 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS

THE OPPORTUNITY:
We're partnering with a well-established and growing business in Macclesfield that is looking to recruit an experienced Finance Assistant to join its busy finance team.
The successful Finance Assistant will support the day-to-day running of the finance function, taking responsibility for purchase ledger and sales ledger transactions, processing invoices, reconciling accounts and assisting with month-end finance activities.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts or finance or a recent graduate in Accounting and Finance experience who enjoys working in a supportive finance team in a business that boasts an impressive portfolio of clients.

THE FINANCE ASSISTANT ROLE:
- Processing purchase invoices, ensuring accurate coding, matching and authorisation
- Managing purchase ledger transactions, maintaining supplier accounts and resolving outstanding queries
- Raising and processing sales invoices, ensuring accurate billing and timely completion
- Maintaining the sales ledger, allocating customer payments and investigating outstanding balances
- Reconciling supplier statements, identifying discrepancies and resolving invoice queries
- Assisting with bank reconciliations and ensuring financial transactions are accurately recorded
- Supporting the Credit Control team with customer account queries and outstanding payment investigations
- Preparing and maintaining accurate financial records, spreadsheets and supporting documentation
- Assisting with supplier payment runs and ensuring invoices are processed within agreed payment terms
- Supporting month-end procedures, including ledger reconciliations, journals and financial reporting
- Liaising with suppliers, customers and internal departments to resolve finance-related queries
- Assisting with the preparation of financial reports and providing administrative support to the wider finance team
- Supporting improvements to existing finance processes and ensuring accurate record keeping

THE PERSON:
- Previous experience within a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Finance Administrator, Purchase Ledger Clerk or Sales Ledger Clerk role or an undergraduate degree in Accounting and Finance
- Experience processing purchase invoices and maintaining purchase ledger records
- Good understanding of sales ledger processes, including raising invoices and allocating customer payments
- Experience completing bank reconciliations and supplier statement reconciliations would be advantageous
- Previous exposure to month-end processes, journals or management accounts support would be beneficial
- Exposure to computerised accounting software would be advantageous
- Good Microsoft Excel skills, including working with spreadsheets, formulas and financial data. Must be able to use Pivot Tables and SUMIFS
- Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Good understanding of accounting principles and day-to-day finance procedures
- Confident communicating with suppliers, customers and internal stakeholders to resolve queries

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
The Purchase Ledger Clerk role is an excellent opportunity for someone with a keen eye for detail and a solid understanding of accounting processes. Based in Crewe, this temporary position offers a chance to contribute meaningfully to a fast-paced department.

Client Details

This organisation is a respected name within the industry. As a medium-sized business, they focus on efficient operations and delivering high-quality service to their clients. They are known for their structured processes and commitment to excellence.

Description
- Accurately process purchase invoices and credit notes in the accounting system.
- Reconcile supplier statements to ensure accurate financial records.
- Handle queries related to purchase ledger accounts promptly and professionally.
- Assist with payment runs, ensuring deadlines are consistently met.
- Maintain organised records and documentation for auditing purposes.
- Collaborate with internal teams to resolve discrepancies in invoices or payments.
- Support month-end processes, including ledger reconciliations.
- Provide general administrative support to the accounting & finance department.

Profile

A successful Purchase Ledger Clerk should have:
- Previous experience in a similar role within the accounting & finance field.
- Proficiency in accounting software and MS Office, particularly Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Effective communication skills for liaising with suppliers and team members.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines in a busy environment.

Job Offer

Immediate start + long term opportunities + hybrid working + free parking + excellent other benefits
